primary_vantage_family_definition.rationale: Separate direct visual counts from counts derived from images while keeping sparse platform-specific categories available for sensitivity diagnostics.

audits: record counts by raw vantage and collapsed vantage family
mixed raw-vantage and mixed family groups
direct versus image-based co-observation groups overall and by species
exact-date and <=14-day direct-image overlap when dates are known
same-family repeated-observation groups by accuracy class
units that change vantage family through time

identification_rules.direct_image_mean_offset: Promote a direct-vs-image mean offset to the primary observation model only if there are at least 20 site-species-season mixed-family groups overall and at least two species each contribute at least 5 such groups.
identification_rules.raw_vantage_offsets: Raw vantage-specific offsets remain sensitivity-only unless every retained category has at least 10 mixed-vantage season groups connecting it directly or indirectly to ground.
identification_rules.accuracy_variance: Estimate separate observation-scale parameters for accuracy classes 1, 2 and pooled 3-5 if each of those three groups has at least 20 repeated-observation season groups; otherwise use the coarser split 1 versus 2-5.
identification_rules.unknown_vantage: Never assign a mean offset from missing vantage; treat missing-vantage records as unknown-method observations and assess them in a sensitivity that excludes them.

boundary: Count magnitudes are not summarized, compared or modeled.
Only metadata and record co-occurrence are used.
The 107-unit season-based cohort and 1980-2025 window are not changed.
Observation-model decisions made here cannot be changed after count magnitudes are opened.
